1.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
1.Dialog: I am Lord of The Great Tomb of Nazarick, Ainz Ooal Gown. I'd like to welcome everyone to the trial.

2.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
2.Dialog: I've split your Militia in two. How you find each other and deal with any problems is up to you.

3.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
3.Dialog: I hope you have fun. I'll be waiting for you at the end.

4.Title: Albedo
4.Dialog: In fact, I'm quite looking forward to it.

1.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
1.Dialog: Interesting. You don't look like much, but your actions speak for themselves.

2.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
2.Dialog: Albedo, I must travel back to Nazarick for a while. Stay here and see if you can gather any useful information.

3.Title: Albedo
3.Dialog: Yes, my Lord. I'll be sure to make this trial a little more interesting for everyone.

1.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
1.Dialog: We've gathered enough information. Albedo, you can stop now.

2.Title: Albedo
2.Dialog: Yes, Lord Ainz. I shall return to Nazarick.

1.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
1.Dialog: Enough, Albedo. I'll take it from here.

2.Title: Albedo
2.Dialog: Yes, my Lord. If you sense any potential danger, you can call upon me.

4.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
4.Dialog: I apologize for the interruption. Now, where were we?

1.Title: Ainz Ooal Gown
1.Dialog: Oh yes, you passed another test. What an interesting trial, indeed.
